resolved_prompt: Compose one continuous single-view vertical image built around exactly one clearly adult woman as the only figure. Every visible face, body, and hand belongs to this same woman. Place a clearly visible strip of background above her entire hairstyle, and keep her complete crown, face, and both eyes clearly readable. Make the name-free visual treatment the unmistakable rendering language across the face, eyes, hair, clothing, silhouette, palette, shading, composition, and motif placement. The validated scene's pose, hand placement, gaze, support leg, camera boundary, and negative-space layout remain equally binding. Preserve a named hand placement only inside that boundary; otherwise preserve its upper-arm direction. Opening camera contract—pull the camera far back, keep the complete crown, both shoes, and visible floor below both shoes inside the canvas, place the figure on one vertical third, and limit the complete figure to at most two-thirds of the canvas height. Create a clean hand-drawn two-dimensional editorial illustration. The exact name-free signature controls the visible medium, face, eyes, silhouette, palette, light, composition, and ornament. Apply this name-free visual treatment: Make these eight cues bold and unmistakable: line language—straight modular contours and evenly spaced seams; face design—full rounded cheeks and a short nose; eye design—large layered irises and paired catchlights; body design—elongated graceful limbs and tapered hands; palette language—large garnet, ink-blue, forest, and gold fields; light modeling—strong translucent colored glaze, reflected color, and open penumbrae across face, sleeves, trousers, and ground; framing language—a tall upright border with a low visual anchor, expressed in the background while the measured camera controls subject placement; ornament language—repeated fine floral lines. Draw face and eye details crisply within the full-length figure. Put the ornament on both the garment and outer border. Keep the complete figure in front of every decorative framing element. Use it to render this validated scene preset: An adult stands frontally with level shoulders and loosely clasped hands in a quiet pale-stone museum hall with deep openings and sparse displays, wearing a belted midi dress with a clean cropped outer layer, with a calm attentive look with a level chin and focused eyes. Use a wide view with the subject on a third and a clear depth path and a large diffused key blended with ambient light. Keep the combined direction coherent. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery. Final camera lock—pull the camera far back, keep the complete crown, both shoes, and visible floor below both shoes inside the canvas, place the figure on one vertical third, and limit the complete figure to at most two-thirds of the canvas height.
